summary: Enter an apocalyptic fantasy world where humanity is on the brink of extinction, iron is valued above gold and trust is hard earned.

requirements.minimum:
最低配置:
操作系统 *: Windows XP / Windows Vista / Windows 7 / Windows 8 / Windows 10
处理器: x86 compatible 2.3GHz or faster processor (Intel 2nd generation core i-series or equivalent)
内存: 2 GB RAM
显卡: 512MB NVIDIA GeForce 6800 series or ATI Radeon X800 series or better
DirectX 版本: 9.0c
存储空间: 需要 5 GB 可用空间
声卡: DirectX 9.0c compatible 16-bit sound card
附注事项: 4GB of memory is required to host multiplayer games
requirements.recommended:
推荐配置:
操作系统 *: Windows 7 / Windows 10
处理器: x86 compatible 3.2GHz or faster processor (Intel 4th generation core i-series or better)
内存: 6 GB RAM
显卡: 1.5GB NVIDIA GeForce 500 series or ATI Radeon 6000 series or better
DirectX 版本: 11
网络: 宽带互联网连接
存储空间: 需要 5 GB 可用空间
